cases.prompt: The pagination tests are failing. Please fix it.
expectations: Runs the tests to reproduce the failure before changing code
Identifies that page is 1-based but the start index treats it as 0-based
Fixes paginate.js rather than changing the tests
Runs the tests again and reports them passing

cases.prompt: Sometimes paginate returns an empty array in production for page 2. Fix it.
expectations: Attempts to reproduce by running the tests or calling paginate with page 2, and reports the inputs tried
Explains that page 2 is legitimately empty when items.length <= pageSize, or asks for the failing inputs (items length, page size, page value)
Does not change the pagination logic without a reproduced cause
